newsitem.title: UK: Heywood Williams says Q1 in line with 96.
newsitem.headline: Heywood Williams says Q1 in line with 96.

text.p: British building and car industry component maker Heywood Williams Group Plc said on Friday that first quarter results were in line with the company's performance last year.

"1997 has started more slowly than expected, but the results for the first quarter very much reflect the performance of last year," executive chairman Ralph Hinchliffe said in a statement from the annual general meeting.

"Improving market conditions are still forecast for our principal markets in the U.S. and Britain, and given such conditions, I expect that 1997 will turn out to be a year of further progress," Hinchcliffe said.
In 1996, the company reported a four percent drop in pre-tax profits to 37.15 million stg. Turnover rose 13.2 percent to 636.8 million.
